task: Require every requested binary judgment by question ID on the Granite wire schema and verify one local Faherty run in D1.
nonGoals: No production migration, deployment, scoring, frontend, or limit changes. No live inference in CI and no merchant data in Git.

outcomes.description: The actual gateway request requires exactly one keyed entry per requested question, with a binary answer and a 300-character reason limit.
outcomes.evidence: Offline request serialization and required-property tests.

outcomes.description: Keyed responses persist with existing D1 fields, incomplete results preserve supported findings, and legacy arrays remain replayable.
outcomes.evidence: Offline normalization and D1 persistence tests.

outcomes.description: Perform one guarded local Faherty model call and verify persisted answer coverage, score and metering.
outcomes.evidence: Readback from local D1 and default gateway usage corroboration, recorded outside Git.

process.description: Record the plan separately, keep calibration private and obtain an independent review and hosted CI.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the existing guarded transport and storage and avoid an application migration.

exitTest.reason: The change replaces a response shape in a stateless local benchmark. It does not change agent resumption or state transfer.
